name: deep gnome
desc: Deep Gnome is a CR 0.5 humanoid.

actions.name: gnome cunning
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The gnome's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .aU62xVUBYkAQWIHv]]{nondetection} (self only) 1/day each: [[/item .zwGsAv6kmwzYGhh3]]{blindness/deafness}, [[/item .UDUnlfPsOAbq2RSE]]{blur}, [[/item .A3q2gTNqG6fvNGrv]]{disguise self}

actions.name: poisoned dart
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must succeed on a [[/save activity=yYJMmbs4vnoxnf8U]] saving throw or be &Reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=yYJMmbs4vnoxnf8U]]. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: stone camouflage
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to &reference[hide] in rocky terrain.
